name: VEROlabs Safe Electrical Work Practices
summary:
Get ready for an exciting journey into the world of industrial safety! Put on your headset and explore up close how to manage electrical hazards and perform secure maintenance on high-voltage systems.

In this interactive VR experience, you will be able to:
• Inspect and equip personal protective equipment (PPE)
• Execute standard Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures on enclosure circuit breaker switches to isolate hazardous energy
• Conduct multi-phase zero-energy verification using a digital multimeter follow
